slides.texte_overlay: A man who knows how to dress for the weather. Wool when it's cold, linen when it's hot. Looking comfortable is the first step to looking elegant.
A good watch on a leather strap. Simple, classic, no logo screaming for attention. Quiet details say more than big brands.
Clean, polished shoes. People notice them more than you think. Well-kept shoes make any outfit look intentional.
Reading a real book in a café. No phone on the table, just a coffee and a story. Few things look more relaxed and confident.
Knowing a little about art and history. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it makes museum visits so much richer.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It makes museum visits so much richer.

slides.texte_overlay: A well-fitted navy suit. Not for every day, but for the moments that matter. A great suit never goes out of style.
Good manners everywhere. Thanking the waiter, holding a door, listening fully. True style is how you treat people.
